g.text: All 17 particle and ion states · ON refined
Illustrative prescribed-bath history · isotope color; ion-stage line style and marker
Fixed isotope multipliers change vertical ordering; compare raw abundances in the CSV.
t = 0 omitted; positive tails below 10⁻⁸: 999 state-samples; above 2: 0. Exact-zero gaps: 0; negative gaps: 0.
All saved raw values retained; no epsilon floors or new time samples. This is elapsed time, not cosmic age or the BBN era.
